PDF Light Weight Space Leaping using Ray Coherence
ABSTRACT We present a space leaping technique for accelerating volume ren-dering with very low space and run-time complexity. Our technique exploits the ray coherence during ray casting by using the distance a ray traverses in empty space to leap its neighboring rays. Our technique works with parallel as well as perspective volume ren-dering, does not require any pre-processing or 3D data ...
